newsitem.title: USA: WebTV, Fujitsu in Japan Internet TV deal.
newsitem.headline: WebTV, Fujitsu in Japan Internet TV deal.

text.p: WebTV Networks Inc. and Fujitsu Ltd on Tuesday said they have agreed to form a venture to start a television-based Internet service in Japan using technology developed by WebTV.

Fujitsu will build a network operations center and provide Internet access and on-line content to the subscription-based WebTV Network service in Japan, the companies said. The WebTV Network service was launched in the U.S. market in September and is the first on-line service to bring easy to use Internet access to televisions at a small fraction of the cost of a personal computer.
